Q: SQLite error 'attempt to write a readonly database' during insert? A:

Just the other day a similar thing happened to me. So rude:

$ sqlite3 /opt/quarto/share/deno_std/cache/dep_analysis_cache_v2 .dump
sql error: attempt to write a readonly database (8)
PRAGMA foreign_keys=OFF;
BEGIN TRANSACTION;
/**** ERROR: (8) attempt to write a readonly database *****/
ROLLBACK; -- due to errors

Nonsense! I did not "attempt to write" anything.

All I did was want a .dump.

Yes, you're going to say,

Has it ever occurred to you to try
$ sqlite3 -readonly?

Yes.

And?

It didn't help.

Well, how about use sudo?

That would be a bad habit, when this workaround exists:

$ cp /opt/quarto/share/deno_std/cache/dep_analysis_cache_v2 /tmp
$ sqlite3 /tmp/dep_analysis_cache_v2 .dump

Q: Color only header with pandas A:

I think you can do that with the css class row_heading.

(See: https://pandas.pydata.org/pandas-docs/stable/user_guide/style.html#CSS-classes)

Another option would be:

df1 = pd.DataFrame('', index=x.index, columns = x.columns)

df1.style.set_table_styles(
   [{
       'selector': 'th',
       'props': [('background-color', '#add8e6')]
   }])

Q: com.ibm.db2.jcc.am.SqlException: Invalid operation: result set is closed. ERRORCODE=-4470, SQLSTATE=null A:

The reason that I got the same error was because I closed the db2 connection and then tried to read the result set. Please put some emphasis on the fact that the db2 must remain connected while reading the result set.
